learning_outcomes.text: Present, challenge and defend solutions to real-life sustainability issues faced by companies and organizations
Organize arguments clearly, cohesively and concisely in speaking and in writing

syllabus_topics: Developing key spoken and written communication skills for future working life
Collaborating in interdisciplinary teams to find solutions to real-life sustainability issues
Researching solutions from particular angles (e.g., design, branding, technical or financial viability)
Structuring arguments and counterarguments in speaking and in writing
Applying different types of reasoning behind argumentation
Receiving constructive feedback on written and spoken argumentation skills
